pages.text: Occultism is the T3 ritual magic mod. Demon summoning, soul extraction, storage dimension, and ritual crafting.

$(bold)Role in the pack:$(/bold) Occultism's Dimensional Storage is the best personal storage solution in T3. Soul Gems are used in Void Summoner builds. Rituals provide unique crafting alternatives for several T3 recipes.$(br2)$(bold)Void Summoner synergy:$(/bold) Occultism's summoned entities interact with the Void Summoner's Soul Tether and Death Harvest passives.
$(bold)Key rituals:$(/bold) Golden Sacrifice (converts mob spawners), Possession ritual (entity capturing for dimensional storage), Summoning rituals for crafting assistants.
Craft the $(bold)Dictionary of Spirits$(/bold) for the full Occultism reference — ritual circles, spirit summoning, djinn work orders, and storage systems.
